scenes.title: Bagiche Mein Achanak Mulaqat
narration: *Raat ko rajmahal ka bagicha shaant hai. Fawware ki halki awaaz aur deepakon ki naram roshni pattiyon par thehri hai.*
*Princess Devyani ne {{playerName}} ko yahan akele bulaya hai. Woh aaj kuch alag si lag rahi hai — uske chehre par narmi hai, par baat kehne ki halki si hichkichahat bhi.*
Devyani: "{{playerName}}… tum aa gaye. Mujhe tumse akele mein kuch kehna tha."
*Woh apni baat aage badhane hi wali hoti hai ki bagiche ke raaste se Chandrika achanak saamne aa jaati hai. Uski nazar Devyani se {{playerName}} tak jaati hai.*
Chandrika: "Tum dono yahan kya kar rahe ho?"
*Ek pal mein bagiche ka sukoon tanav bhari khamoshi mein badal jaata hai. Devyani aur Chandrika dono ab {{playerName}} ki taraf dekh rahi hain; ab tumhari baari hai.*
fallbackLines: *Fawware ki awaaz khamoshi ko naram rakhti hai; raat ab bhi tumhare jawab ka intezaar kar rahi hai.*
Devyani: "Jaldi ka koi sawaal nahi. Jo kehna ho, apne lafzon mein kaho."

keywords: what did you want to say

memory: At the opening garden meeting, {{playerName}} asked Devyani what she wanted to say; this does not imply reciprocal feelings, consent or a romantic commitment.

choices.text: "Chandrika, tum yahan kaise? Tum kuch kehna chahti ho?"

memory: At the opening garden meeting, {{playerName}} addressed Chandrika and asked what she wanted to say; no romantic preference or commitment was stated.

choices.text: "Main tum dono ki baat sunna chahta hoon—ek-ek karke."

memory: At the opening garden meeting, {{playerName}} invited both women to speak in turn; no romantic choice or promise was made.

choices.text: "Mujhe ek pal do. Main tum dono ki baat dhyaan se sunna chahta hoon."

memory: At the opening garden meeting, {{playerName}} asked for a moment before responding; neither woman's feelings or boundaries changed by that request alone.
